description: This is a test class 'SanitizerTest' for the 'Sanitizer' utility in the OrangeHRM project, focused on sanitizing SVG content to remove malicious scripts and attributes. It includes multiple test methods that verify the sanitizer's behavior against various SVG inputs, ensuring security and correctness.

classes.name: SanitizerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit-based test class for testing SVG sanitization functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Sanitizer instance and DOMDocument before each test.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithScriptTag
methods.description: Verifies that SVG containing a scripting tag is sanitized by removing script tags.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithOnClick
methods.description: Ensures that SVG with inline event handlers like 'onclick' have these attributes removed after sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithAnimate
methods.description: Checks that SVG with animation elements with event handlers are sanitized.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithRegularSVG
methods.description: Tests that a well-formed, non-malicious SVG remains unchanged after sanitization.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithBadlyFormattedSVG
methods.description: Ensures that badly formatted SVG input throws a SanitizerException with the message 'SVG is badly formatted.'
